notes: R2 converged three independently-advanced program heads — UI-NEXT through 3.1 with T-NEXT through 4 as the base, V-NEXT through 2B.6 merged onto it, and the M64 route repair plus the two R1 recovery commits cherry-picked — onto one trunk. R1 was cherry-picked rather than merged because its branch sits on the condensed voice line, which would have contested V-NEXT's ownership of the voice runtime. The V-NEXT merge produced exactly two textual conflicts, resolved COMBINE and ADAPT and recorded in the manifest. Convergence exposed four real defects that no single input line could have surfaced alone; all four are repaired in this trunk. Certification was rebuilt so it cannot lie about what it tested: frontend and backend each report their SHA and worktree at runtime, the certificate records both, and the run fails closed if they disagree or if a foreign backend origin is observed. At this SHA the trunk is integrated, locally tested, and browser-certified, and it is neither published nor CI-verified nor merged. Those are three distinct unmet conditions and none of them may be reported as completion.
